newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close lower ahead of holidays.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close lower ahead of holidays.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed lower on selling of a highly capitalised blue chip, with the rest of the market holding its ground, brokers said.

The all share index closed 1.2 points down at 595.8. Price gains led declines by 17 to 13, but 500 shares of Development Finance Corporation, a highly capitalised blue chip, trading 9.75 rupees down at 260, dragged the index lower.
"Nothing will happen until January. You cannot contact investors to get confirmation, even when you have shares they have been looking for," said broker Gordon Nadesan of CT Smith.
Turnover was 16.1 million rupees on 390,457 shares, led by foreign buying of 55,000 John Keells Holdings at 195 rupees.
A block of 99,294 Mikechris Industries at 22 rupees, which came on bid on last Friday on an all-or-nothing basis, will be concluded on Friday December 27.
The exchange will be closed for the Christmas holidays on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
